name: IconButton
summary: Perform an icon-only action with an explicit accessible name and square Button sizing.

useWhen: A compact action is represented by one icon, such as close, search, or settings.
avoidWhen: The action needs visible text; use Button.
Navigating to a destination; use Link.

obligations: Requires a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby; referenced labeling elements must exist and contain meaningful text.
Caller-supplied icon content is decorative; do not place focusable or interactive elements inside it.
Pending preserves the accessible name and keyboard focusability while suppressing activation.
Disabled suppresses activation and removes the button from keyboard tab order.

behavior: Composes Mux Button; onActivate, refs, form attributes, and finite variants follow Button.
Renders caller-supplied icon children in a decorative wrapper.
Square sm, md, and lg sizes follow Mux minimum control heights; pending replaces the icon without changing geometry.
The pending indicator is static; showTextWhileLoading is not part of this icon-only API.
accessibility: Requires a non-empty aria-label or aria-labelledby; referenced labeling elements must exist and contain meaningful text.

Disabled suppresses activation and removes the button from keyboard tab order.
